mission: Find a polynomial exact law for composing heterogeneous tractable islands in arbitrary SAT/CSP without unbounded assignment/interface enumeration.

source_native_positive_controls.source: Ganian–Ordyniak–Szeider, A Join-Based Hybrid Parameter for Constraint Satisfaction, arXiv:1907.12335
source_native_positive_controls.fact: Exact CSP solving can be organized as join + projection + pruning along a join decomposition; bounded joinwidth with a supplied decomposition yields polynomial solving.
source_native_positive_controls.limitation: Width is measured by explicit intermediate relation cardinality; bounded joinwidth is not universal and finding optimal decompositions is hard in general.

source_native_positive_controls.source: Wang–Mauá–Van den Broeck–Choi, A Compositional Atlas for Algebraic Circuits, arXiv:2412.05481
source_native_positive_controls.fact: Over the Boolean semiring, conjunction is product and existential projection is aggregation. Smooth decomposable circuits support linear-time aggregation. Compatible products are polynomial; X-support-compatible products are linear in max input size, and compatibility properties are preserved through suitable compositions.
source_native_positive_controls.role: Published exact interaction law at the representation level.

sources: Boros–Hammer–Sun, Recognition of q-Horn formulae in linear time, Discrete Applied Mathematics 55 (1994)
source_native_positive_controls.fact: q-Horn properly contains Horn and Krom/2CNF and has linear-time recognition/solving; its tractability is certified by a global literal/variable decomposition rather than enumeration of all assignments.
source_native_positive_controls.role: Concrete positive example that heterogeneous local clause types can compose polynomially when supplied with a compact compatibility certificate.

negative_controls.source: Satisfiability of mixed Horn formulas, Discrete Applied Mathematics 155 (2007)
negative_controls.fact: A formula consisting of a Horn part plus a 2-CNF part is NP-complete in general.
negative_controls.lesson: Simply tagging each constraint by a tractable carrier is insufficient; a cross-carrier compatibility law is mandatory.

negative_controls.source: Expander CNFs have Exponential DNNF Size
negative_controls.fact: There are monotone read-3 2-CNF formulas requiring exponential DNNF size.
negative_controls.lesson: Even a polynomial-time SAT carrier such as Krom cannot always be converted to polynomial-size DNNF; generic DNNF cannot be the universal summary currency.

negative_controls.source: A Compositional Atlas of Tractable Circuit Operations
negative_controls.fact: Exact product of two structured-decomposable deterministic circuits is hard without compatibility, whereas compatibility yields a polynomial product construction.
negative_controls.lesson: Small local representations alone do not imply cheap composition.

sources: Backdoors into heterogeneous classes of SAT and CSP
Discovering Archipelagos of Tractability for Constraint Satisfaction and Counting
negative_controls.fact: Known heterogeneous/scattered backdoor methods obtain FPT tractability by controlling a parameter and normally enumerate assignments or otherwise pay parameter dependence.
negative_controls.lesson: These are architecture donors, not a universal polynomial interaction certificate.

derived_synthesis.name: TYPED_NATIVE_SUMMARY_JOIN_CALCULUS
derived_synthesis.principle: Do not convert every island into one universal representation. Keep each island in its native compact calculus and require a polynomial bridge certificate at every join/projection boundary.

node_state.relation: exact extendability relation of the processed subinstance on its live boundary
node_state.representation: one tagged native format from a finite library
node_state.certificate: proof that the next join/projection between the two tagged formats is exact and polynomial

admitted_bridge_examples: edge-term join/projection where a common edge polymorphism is preserved

new_gate.question: Does every 3CNF admit, in polynomial time, a join decomposition in which every intermediate boundary relation has a polynomial-size tagged native summary and every internal join/projection has a polynomial-size exact bridge certificate from the admitted library?
pass_contract: decomposition construction polynomial in original L
number of nodes polynomial in L
every native summary size polynomial in L
every bridge certificate size polynomial in L
total cumulative state/history polynomial in L
root nonemptiness and witness reconstruction polynomial
immediate_fail_conditions: any family forcing exponential summary in every admitted native format
any required mixed join equivalent to unrestricted mixed Horn+Krom or another known NP-hard mixed core
any hidden conversion to generic DNNF/OBDD with known exponential lower bound
semantic/SAT oracle used to choose the representation or bridge
